en.title: Has Vowels
en.description:
Given an array of lowercase strings. A closed-range query [i,r] (1-based) asks how many strings in it both start and end with a vowel a/e/i/o/u.

See below for this site's input/output protocol; the source repository's solution is not executed.
en.input: The first line contains n q; the next line contains n non-empty lowercase strings; then q lines follow, each i-r. 1≤n,q≤100000, string length 1..10, 1≤i≤r≤n.
en.output: Output the answer to each query on its own line.
en.explanation: Following the source's explanation, use 1-based closed ranges.
hints: Following the source's explanation, use 1-based closed ranges.
